title: The BOAT
blurb: "Brightest Of All Time". The brightest gamma-ray burst ever recorded, estimated as a once-in-10,000-years event.
note: Swift's BAT triggered at 14:10 UT, about 53 minutes after Fermi saw the main blast (GCN 32632, 32636), so the fluence below covers only the later emission.

title: From the cosmic dawn
blurb: At redshift about 8, its light set out roughly 13 billion years ago, when the universe was about 630 million years old.

title: Distance record, 2005
blurb: At redshift 6.29, the most distant explosion known when Swift caught it.

title: Nearby monster
blurb: One of the most energetic bursts ever seen, and unusually close, at redshift 0.34.

title: The naked-eye burst
blurb: Its optical flash was briefly bright enough to see without a telescope, from 7.5 billion light-years away.

title: The burst that broke the rules
blurb: A long burst with no supernova, which challenged the simple long/short picture.
